run_mustc_data_prep: run the MuST-C data preparation script to extract features and generate manifests for speech-to-text tasks
run_mustc_joint_vocab: run the joint processing to build a shared vocabulary across all 8 MuST-C languages
create_mustc_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for MuST-C that yields waveforms, sample rates, and source and target utterances
extract_fbank_features: extract log mel filter bank features from audio waveforms and save them as numpy arrays
generate_mustc_manifests: generate TSV manifest files and config YAML for MuST-C data splits with vocabulary and normalization settings
